findings.title: Real handoff path accepts draft counters without authoritative continuity checks
evidence: preserveRunState is tested as a helper but is not called by the real handoff/status path.
Actual status CLI accepted round=2, absoluteUpdate=800, opened=2 with a nonexistent checkpoint and returned exit 0/stageStatus=completed.
The same CLI then accepted regressed counters 0/0/0 and returned exit 0/stageStatus=completed.
It also accepted round=-1, absoluteUpdate=-1, opened=4 with exit 0/stageStatus=completed.
The actual repository budget ledger remained byte-identical throughout these probes.
findings.impact: A changed or stale draft can misreport inherited progress and available confirmation attempts. The required C0 nonzero round/opened continuity probe has not been satisfied through the actual path.
findings.qualification: This demonstrates an enforcement defect; it does not establish that any real prior REVIEW6 run or opened attempt was erased.
findings.requiredChange: Derive inherited counters from verified persistent cycle/run/checkpoint/opened records, reject draft disagreement and invalid state, and test the real CLI. Until resume is supported, reject unsupported nonzero states explicitly.
